items.exampleEn: We bought an oval table for the dining room.
items.exampleZh: 我們為飯廳買了一張橢圓形的桌子。

items.exampleEn: Please reply promptly to customer emails.
items.exampleZh: 請迅速回覆客戶的電子郵件。

items.exampleEn: Excuse me, is this seat by the window vacant?
items.exampleZh: 不好意思，窗邊這個位子有人坐嗎？

items.exampleEn: Five adults can travel comfortably in this car.
items.exampleZh: 這台車可以讓五個大人舒適地乘坐。

items.exampleEn: She gave a superb performance in the final concert.
items.exampleZh: 她在最後一場音樂會上的表現極為出色。

items.exampleEn: This printer is compatible with both of our computers.
items.exampleZh: 這台印表機和我們兩台電腦都相容。

items.exampleEn: Ideally, we would finish the project by Friday.
items.exampleZh: 最理想的情況是，我們在星期五前完成這個專案。

items.exampleEn: His work this year has been satisfactory.
items.exampleZh: 他今年的工作表現令人滿意。

items.sentenceEn: The apartment on the third floor has been vacant since March.
items.sentenceZh: 三樓的公寓從三月起就一直空著。

items.audioEn: Thank you for replying so promptly. We can start the project tomorrow.
items.audioZh: 謝謝你這麼快回覆。我們明天就可以開始這個專案。
items.questionZh: 說話者為什麼感謝對方？

items.sentenceEn: Ideally, everyone should take a short break every hour.
items.sentenceZh: 理想上，每個人每小時都應該稍微休息一下。

items.sentenceEn: After the long hike, I slept comfortably in a warm bed.
items.sentenceZh: 長途健行之後，我在溫暖的床上睡得很舒服。

items.stemEn: My sister and her husband are very ____; they rarely argue.
items.stemZh: 我的姊妹和她先生很合得來，很少吵架。

items.stemEn: The meal was ____; it was the best fish I have ever had.
items.stemZh: 這頓飯棒極了；那是我吃過最好吃的魚。

items.passageEn: Our company held its annual meeting at a hotel by the sea. Ideally, we would have chosen a place near the airport, but none of those hotels had enough vacant rooms. The hotel we chose was a pleasant surprise. The meeting room was large, and we could all sit comfortably during long talks. It had a huge oval table, and the big screen was compatible with our laptops, so there were no technical problems. The staff answered our requests promptly, and the food was superb. The only part that was merely satisfactory was the internet, which was a little slow. We will undoubtedly go back next year.
items.passageZh: 我們公司在一家海邊的飯店舉辦年度會議。最理想的是找機場附近的地方，但那些飯店的空房都不夠。我們選的這家飯店令人驚喜。會議室很大，長時間的演講中大家都能坐得很舒服。裡面有一張很大的橢圓形桌子，大螢幕和我們的筆電也相容，所以沒有任何技術問題。工作人員迅速回應我們的要求，食物也棒極了。網路是唯一還算過得去的部分，速度有點慢。我們明年一定還會再去。

questions.questionZh: 他們為什麼沒有選機場附近的飯店？
這家飯店的哪一方面只算過得去？

items.promptZh: 這家餐廳的服務令人滿意，但不算出色。
referenceEn: The service at this restaurant was satisfactory, but not excellent.
This restaurant's service is satisfactory but not exceptional.
rubricZh: satisfactory 表示「令人滿意的、過得去的」，當形容詞（例如 was satisfactory）
「不算出色」可寫 not excellent、not exceptional、nothing special 等

items.promptZh: 這種植物最好放在陽光充足的地方。
referenceEn: This plant should ideally be kept in a sunny place.
Ideally, this kind of plant should be kept somewhere sunny.
rubricZh: ideally 表示「最好是、理想上」，可放句首或助動詞後（例如 Ideally, …、should ideally be 等）
「陽光充足的地方」可寫，例如 a sunny place、somewhere sunny 等
